notes.title: 1.5.5 IS OUT!
notes.content:
[b][h1]What's new?[/h1][/b]

[h3][b]- New Sidequest that will evolve further down the line [Outside the furniture shop].

- Went through the whole list of feedback and fixed many things to make an even better gameplay experience.[/b][/h3]

[h1]THANKS FOR ALL THE FEEDBACK![/h1]

notes.title: Fixes and addons!
notes.content:
- FIxes for some smaller issues.
- Made some coding cleaner.
- Added More music to the already big Indie Music Soundtrack!

This is not the last update. More to come later.

Big Underground Area [N-U 1-3]
New Side-quest with great award!
New Boss
New funny NPC Character
Updated Loading Screen with the new Subtitle!

BIGGER Indie Soundtrack [Over 30 Indie artists in this game with multiple songs each!]

notes.title: Minor fixes and new stuff added!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Minor fixes:[/h2][/b]
[b]- Unequipping the Torch now stops the animation as it should after a boss and leaving area.
(If you already defeated that boss, go inside your built house to make the animation of the torch go away).
- Unable to pick up one optional thing is now fixed.
- Collision detection fixed in some areas.[/b]

[b][h2]Addition:[/h2][/b]
[b]- A new house with interior has been added [i][G-4][/i].[/b]

More things will be added like side-quests, locations, items, crafting and more as the time goes.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Huge Update!! Depths of Insanity 1.2 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43661852/2c1251c657cc146ae4496c8832ab3f44396dae95.png[/img][h1]A BIG Update is here![/h1]

[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[h3][b]
- Big Performance Boost!

- Better enemy fluidity.

- Swords durablity boosted.

- In-Game Achievements Section.

- Egg splash animation from chicken "gun".

- Mini-Game Brainswap Dungeon.

- Mini-Game Lollipop Plop.

- Prices in furniture store updated.

- Red rocks materials now have a great purpose when crafting.

- Having all 3 Gold minerals can craft a good item at home.

- A huge side-quest from the beginning of the game.

- More Music to collect for the Walkman and Stereo in game.
          
Artists in game so far:
          [list]
          [*] Raise Cain [Swe 90s Metal]
          [*] Florin Rocks [Swe Metal]
          [*] Superposition [US Metal]
          [*] Kenny Crossley [US Rap Artist]
[/list]
          And more coming!

- Music Video (Burned my life with Raise Cain) for the VCR-item in game.[/b][/h3]
